definitions.explanation: The person who owns or possesses something. Can refer to the owner of physical objects or the possessor of qualities or abilities.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}は{誰|だれ}ですか。
examples.english: Who is the owner of this car?

examples.japanese: {落|お}とし{物|もの}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: The owner of the lost item was found.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{素晴|すば}らしい{才能|さいのう}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
examples.english: She is the possessor of wonderful talent.

notes:
{持|も}ち{主|ぬし} combines {持|も}ち (holding, from {持|も}つ) + {主|ぬし} (master, owner). It refers to the owner of objects or the possessor of qualities and abilities.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: the owner of ~
- {落|お}とし{物|もの}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: owner of lost property
- {才能|さいのう}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: person of talent
- {美声|びせい}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: person with a beautiful voice
- {不思議|ふしぎ}な{力|ちから}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: possessor of mysterious power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {持|も}ち{主|ぬし}: owner (everyday, also for abstract qualities)
- {所有者|しょゆうしゃ}: owner (formal, legal contexts, objects only)
- オーナー: owner (business, loanword)

USAGE:
Unlike {所有者|しょゆうしゃ}, which is limited to physical or legal ownership, {持|も}ち{主|ぬし} is frequently used for personal qualities: {優|やさ}しさの{持|も}ち{主|ぬし} (a kind person).
